tasks.goal: Establish the compatible unified delivery-item schema, model and application persistence contract.
input_facts: V45 is the current local Flyway schema
Existing delivery rows require UNIT key backfill
invariants: Existing ordinary delivery rows remain readable
Only file-media rows may have a null artifact version
interface_contracts: Create and update requests retain deliveries and add fileMedia
action_bounds: Modify only migration, application model, application Store and their contract tests
acceptance_checks: Schema contract proves all three tables are migrated and backfilled
Persistence SQL uses item_type, file_path and item_key
Focused tests and release compile pass
evidence_required: Focused Maven command and exit code
tasks.rollback: Revert scoped source changes before V46 is applied; after application, use a later compensating migration.
stop_conditions: Existing duplicate rows cannot be backfilled uniquely
A required consumer lies outside approved scope
escalation_conditions: Fixed FILE mapping or path identity must change

Workflow contract requires platform workflow changes
